description: the Overview sidebar shares the page's --surface-0 ground in both themes, with the split carried by the 1px --edge hairline plus the left-cast --shadow-overview, and the mobile variant carries neither (spec 2026-11-28)

mutation.note: Verified by running the combined case against the pre-change code: the Overview backgrounds resolved to canvas instead of the page values, boxShadow was none, and z-index was auto.
